subject.title: Inconsistent message:sent / message_sent hook coverage across multiple outbound dispatch paths

question: Should remaining outbound lifecycle coverage be centralized behind a shared exactly-once observer/reporting seam, or split into per-surface fixes for Gateway/WebChat/TUI/native channel delivery?
rationale: Current source shows real remaining gaps, but the right fix crosses gateway delivery, channel plugins, public plugin SDK shape, and security-sensitive hook semantics; automation should not choose that product/API boundary alone.

options.title: Centralize the lifecycle seam
options.body: Define a shared exactly-once sent-delivery observer/reporting contract, then land narrow implementations for each remaining delivery surface against that contract.

options.title: Split into canonical per-surface issues
options.body: Keep the umbrella open only as tracking context while maintainers assign separate Gateway, TUI, native channel, and plugin-SDK fixes.

options.title: Continue per-channel ad hoc fixes
options.body: Accept lower API churn now, but expect recurring drift and duplicate hook-ordering decisions across channels.

recommendation.title: Centralize the lifecycle seam
recommendation.body: Define a shared exactly-once sent-delivery observer/reporting contract, then land narrow implementations for each remaining delivery surface against that contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has recent adjacent gateway and outbound architecture history and is the best available routing owner for the cross-surface product/API decision.
